headline: SEA @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.57 at HOU 3.27, with a projected total of 7.85. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved -0.41 runs while HOU moved -0.94, changing the projected margin by +0.53 runs. The projected total fell -1.34, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +25.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: detailed start-by-start logs were not available for every starter, so the page separates actual starts from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Julio Rodríguez, Jose Altuve, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Cal Raleigh, Cole Young because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
